features.quote: The 30-Turn Economizer. While spiral characterization can run to 100 turns, regression testing caps at 30. Empirical piloting shows >92% of spirals are clinically obvious by turn 18.
features.justification_quote: The marginal cost of turns 30–100 improves detection by <3%.
